item.title: Home
item.description: When classic rock meets the blues, modern rock mingled rhythmically with indie and pop mixed with a bit of electronic music... Welcome to JB Radio! JB Radio is an alternative,non-commercial,web radio station. Our plan is to give you a mixture with many genres of eclectic music from all over the world,between past and present,mixed together harmonically, with no advertisements,no breaks and no "bla-bla" words between songs. At JB Radio you will have a new experience of high quality audio. Select
